title: Vikings GM Nolan Teasley on Kyle Van Noy signing: Veteran presence at a premium position

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Vikings GM Nolan Teasley on Kyle Van Noy signing: Veteran presence at a premium position
sources.description: The Vikings picked up one of the top veteran free agents still on the market this week when they signed linebacker Kyle Van Noy to their practice squad.
